**Image 1 (Stacked View): 8/10**
*Visual Fixes:*
- **Canvas legibility**: The flowsheet is heavily compressed; increase vertical padding or allow pinch-to-zoom so stream labels and unit boxes are readable.
- **Data density**: The “Plant Answer” grid (Production/Purity/Per-pass) feels cramped—add slight row spacing or reduce font weight to improve scanability.
- **Critic Verdict alignment**: The “95/100” score appears slightly misaligned with the “PASS” badge; vertically center both elements.
- **Bottom nav collision**: The “New session” button and “Zoom in/Saved” icons sit very close to the instructional text; add ~8px margin to prevent tap-target overlap.

**Image 2 (Collapsed / Canvas‑Only): 6/10**
*Visual Fixes:*
- **Floating button placement**: The “Session” button overlaps the legend bar (FEED/PROCESS GAS/NH3/UTILITIES), obscuring text. Relocate it to the top‑right (near “BUILD OK”) or bottom‑center with a higher z‑index and shadow.
- **Empty void**: The lower 40% of the screen is dead space. Either center the flowsheet vertically, add a subtle grid/background pattern, or show a minimized “chat preview” strip.
- **Legend truncation**: “NH3” and “UTILITIES” are cut off by the floating button; shorten labels or move the legend into an expandable drawer.
- **Context loss**: No indication that a chat/session exists below. Add a subtle upward chevron (↑) or “Chat” tooltip on the Session button to reveal the stacked state.

**Summary:** Image 1 succeeds as a functional dashboard but needs breathing room for the diagram. Image 2 offers a clean canvas mode but suffers from UI element collisions and wasted real estate; the floating action button needs repositioning to avoid hiding critical legend data.
